name: SentenceCase
description: The heading rewritten in sentence case, keeping words like API and JavaScript as written, for a rule's suggest action.

name: TitleCase
description: The heading rewritten in title case, with short articles, conjunctions, and prepositions left lowercase, for a rule's suggest action.

name: errors
description: Only error-level rules, for a hook or a CI step that should block on nothing else.

name: no-spelling
description: Every rule but the spell checker, for a run over text full of names Vale doesn't know.

name: no-suggestions
description: Errors and warnings only, for a CI step that should report what needs fixing and leave the rest to the editor.

name: spelling
description: Only the spell checkers, for building a vocabulary from what a first run flags.

name: HeadingNumbers
description: Numbered headings, such as 1. and 1.2, that skip or repeat a number, for a script rule scoped to raw Markdown.

name: ListPunctuation
description: A list where some items end with a period and others don't, for a script rule scoped to raw Markdown.

name: github
description: GitHub Actions annotations, one per alert, so each shows on its line in the pull request.

name: gitlab
description: A GitLab Code Quality report, so alerts show in the merge request widget and the changes view.

name: jsonl
description: JSON Lines, one object per alert, for a tool or an agent that reads alerts one at a time.

name: junit
description: JUnit XML, a test case per alert, for a CI system that shows test reports but nothing else.

name: rdjsonl
description: reviewdog's rdjsonl, one diagnostic per line, for reviewdog to post as review comments.

name: sarif
description: SARIF 2.1.0, for code scanning, where each alert keeps a history and can be dismissed with a reason.

name: summary
description: A Markdown summary with a table per file and the totals, for a pull request comment or a job summary.

name: AndroidStrings
description: The text of each string and plural in an Android resource file, with names and untranslatable strings left alone.

name: AppleStrings
description: The values of an Apple .strings file, with the keys and comments left alone.

name: CRD
description: Every description in a Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinition's schema, read as Markdown.

name: Commit
description: A commit message as a subject, a body, and trailers, each its own scope.

name: GraphQL
description: The block and single-line descriptions in a GraphQL schema, read as Markdown.

name: I18nJSON
description: Every string in an i18n JSON file, flat or nested, with the keys left alone.

name: I18nYAML
description: Every string in a Rails-style locale file, with the keys left alone.

name: JSONSchema
description: Every title and description in a JSON Schema, written in JSON or YAML.

name: OpenAPI
description: The title and every description and summary in an OpenAPI document, read as Markdown.

name: Python
description: Comments and docstrings in Python source, read as Markdown.

name: Subtitles
description: The cue text of a SubRip file, with the indexes and timings left alone.

name: Transcript
description: A chat transcript, exposing only the model's turns so the prompts are never linted.

name: WebVTT
description: The cue text of a WebVTT file, with the header, identifiers, timings, and notes left alone.

name: AWS
description: AWS service and tool names the built-in dictionary doesn't know, such as Textract, FSx, and botocore.

name: KubernetesTerms
description: Kubernetes resource kinds and ecosystem tools the built-in dictionary doesn't know, such as kubeadm, CSIDriver, and kustomize.
